_comment_risk: 2% of total portfolio per trade. Position size computed by Python, not LLM.
_comment_confidence: QuantAgent confidence must exceed this threshold for a setup to reach StrategyAgent.
_comment_sl: Default SL = entry ± (ATR_14 × 1.5). StrategyAgent may narrow but not widen.
_comment_tp: Minimum reward-to-risk ratio of 2:1 for a setup to be included in playbook.
_comment_utilization: Spend 100% of available cash across max_open_positions.
_comment_min_pos: Ignore setups where position size would be < €20. Fees kill profitability on tiny trades.
_comment_fees: Binance spot taker fee: 0.1%. Used for net position sizing.
